node.description: Id of exactly one development {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

owner.description: The owner (user) of the workflow; default: inventory.owner of the {node}

diagramGroup.description: The diagram group of the workflow

workflow.description: The workflow to switch; its workspace file must not have unimported edits

reason.description: Why; becomes the check-in comment of the new version and is audited (no # or @)

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call; executes the change
